pkgmetadata.longdescription: The Rollup JavaScript bundler built from source: its command-line tool (rollup's TypeScript and the npm packages its build bundles in, bundled with esbuild) and its JavaScript parser (Rust) as a native Node.js addon. Installed per Rollup version in /usr/lib/rollup/VERSION/. Used by www-client/chromium instead of the @rollup/wasm-node npm package it bundles (generated JavaScript and a prebuilt WebAssembly parser). Watch mode and the JavaScript API are not included.
